thread:
oncall-bot: Pager SEV2 — high 95/99 latency and elevated 504s for text-gen in us-west1. Rule: latency-tail > 1000ms for 10m. Please ack.

alex: taking it. Oncall here. starting triage — p95/p99 are climbing for the text-gen route, embeddings look fine. Seeing higher queue times on runtime nodes.

deploy-bot: Automatic action: routed 10% traffic to fallback-model-v2 while investigation proceeds. (action-id: a1b2c3)

alex: thanks. Jordan, can you pull the last 30m of runtime logs and KV cache miss rates? I think I saw cache churn earlier.

jordan: grabbing logs. quick grep shows a pattern — connection churn to node pool p-west-3 around 2043219600..2043219800.

jordan: paste logs:
```
2024-08-17T14:00:12Z runtime[p-west-3]: EVT connection lost to worker-42
2024-08-17T14:00:18Z runtime[p-west-3]: KVCache miss rate 23% (baseline 2%)
2024-08-17T14:01:05Z proxy[p-west]: 504 upstream timeout -> model-serve-12 (cold)
```

tina: +1 on KV cache churn. Also seeing an autoscaler loop — new nodes spin up but aren't joining the pool fast enough (init scripts timing out), so traffic gets routed to cold replicas.

mike: I'm hitting the console — pods show Ready=False for several new workers, with `failed to start kvcache-service` in logs. Looks like a rollout of kernel image 1.13 landed ~14:00 and the init container config didn't include the new env var KEYSTORE_PATH. That would explain init failures.

alex: that matches. Immediate mitigation plan:
- rollback kernel image on p-west-3 to 1.12 (deploy-bot)
- increase fallback routing to 40% for 10m to relieve pressure
- throttle non-critical batch jobs in us-west1
- notify support/CS for customers above impact threshold

alex: deploy-bot, please rollback 1.13 to 1.12 on p-west-3.

deploy-bot: Rolling back kernel image on p-west-3 to 1.12 -> started. Will update when done.

emily: I'll open a quick support incident table and flag customers with >1% p99 increase. Linking to the incident channel and a short blurb for CS.

ops-manager: tagging for customer-impact: please summarize list in 10m so we can prepare comms if needed. Also schedule handoff notes for the night oncall.

jordan: rollback completed at 2043219845. New nodes are joining; KVCache miss rate trending back down toward baseline.

alex: observed p95 dropped from 1100ms -> 320ms in last 3m. Good. 504s are dropping too. Thanks everyone.

alex: quick handoff checklist for next oncall (mike):
- Verify there are no pending deploys to kernel image 1.13 in the pipeline (check deploy queue)
- Watch KVCache miss rate for 30m, alert on >5%
- Confirm rollout gating added to kernel-image pipeline (don't re-deploy without KEYSTORE_PATH env)
- Update incident ticket with root-cause notes and assign postmortem owner

mike: got it. I'll take oncall for the handoff window. Also will patch the init container in staging now.

tina: suggested postmortem owner: emily (product infra) + jordan (runtime). Recommend triage timeboxed to 1 hour tomorrow and full postmortem doc by EOD+2.

emily: happy to co-own. Proposed postmortem agenda:
- timeline (what happened, detection)
- root cause analysis (missing env var in init -> init fails -> cold replicas -> cache churn)
- mitigation chronology (rollback, routing fallback)
- action items + owners + deadlines
- retro / brown-bag scheduling (cross-team)

alex: action items from quick sync (assigning now):
- emily: create postmortem doc and invite owners (due EOD+2)
- jordan: add unit/integration test to detect missing init env vars in pipeline (due +7d)
- tina: update runbook with autoscaler failure mode and throttling steps (due +3d)
- mike: ensure pipeline gating for kernel-image rollouts (due +3d)
- ops-manager: prepare customer-impact list and draft comms (due +1d)

emily: created postmortem doc stub — https://notes.redwood.ai/pm/2043219876 (will fill details). scheduling a 45m postmortem sync: tomorrow 16:00 PDT. Pinged calendar.

ops-manager: customer-impact list posted in support ticket #INC-2024-178. Top affected customers: acme-inc, blue-analytics (both flagged for direct outreach). Support will start contacting with status update template.

jordan: PR for test to fail pipeline if init env missing: https://git.redwood/infra/pipelines/pull/482 — marking assignee: jordan, reviewers: tina. CI run queued.

tina: runbook PR in progress, adding explicit autoscaler check and a `scaleback` script snippet. snippet:
```
# quick scaleback
kubectl patch hpa runtime -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":3}}'
# throttle batch queue
./ops/throttle-batches --region us-west1 --factor 0.3
```

mike: will also add a dashboard panel for `init_failures/sec` and an alert if >1/min over 5m.

emily: planning a brown-bag sharing this incident and prevention patterns next week — proposed Wed 11:00 PT. Will cover pipeline gating, runbook updates, and a demo of the KVCache metrics to watch.

alex: thanks all. Closing active mitigation now; keep an eye on the dashboard for the next 60m. Postmortem ownership: emily/jordan. Handoff complete to mike.

mike: acked. If anything spikes I'll re-escalate. Good job team. :tada:

oncall-bot: Incident resolved (auto): latency rule recovered. Closing pager. Incident ID: INC-2043219876. Metrics: p99 before 1700ms -> after 280ms. Thanks.

emily: after-action note: please add any omissions to the postmortem doc. I'll assign tasks in the doc and link to PRs/tickets.

ops-manager: will coordinate the brown-bag invite and ensure product + platform + eng-sre are on the attendee list. Expect calendar invite from emily.

alex: small follow-up — add a gating check to CI that validates `KEYSTORE_PATH` presence for any kernel-image bump. Jordan/mike to coordinate. Closing thread.
